title: Section 700.11 – Add a new Section 700.11 to read as follows:
officialText:
700.11 Generator Supply Conductors without Overcurrent Protection.
(A) Conductors Ampacity. See 445.13 of this code.
(B) Installation of Generator Conductors. Conductors from the generator output terminal to the first overcurrent
device shall be installed in accordance with 230.6.
(C) Overcurrent Devices. The number of overcurrent devices supplied by the generator shall not be limited.
